authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 10104 māsa explicitly gives Khowar mas “moon, month”, Torwali mah “month”, Lahnda māh and widespread eastern mās “month”. The semantic distinction in each survey is preserved; this is not the homophonous flesh word, and bare mā/mõ contractions are excluded without a local paradigm.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 3865.1 khādati gives Prakrit khāaï, Hindi khānā, Punjabi khāṇā, Nepali khānu, Gujarati khāvũ and eastern khāibā/khāeb. Only simple verb/infinitive forms are selected here; past stems belonging to khādita and khā-le completive constructions require separate analysis.
